text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Correlation of the half-hourly anomalies of each GSP group's AGV and each zone's INDDEM (latest issue), 1 September 2025 to 20 September 2026, after removing from each the multiple of the national anomaly that a least-squares fit gives. An anomaly is a series minus its mean at the same UK local half-hour, day type, and month. NGED's four groups are the top rows. The median over all 238 cells is 0.42 for the raw series, 0.07 for the anomalies, and -0.01 with the national anomaly removed.'
